# Shipping and delivery

Orders placed before 2 p.m. Eastern ship the same business day. Items from different warehouses are shipped seperately and may arrive on different days; you will recieve a tracking number for each package.

Delivery times are estimated by the carrier and are not guaranteed. Standard shipping takes three to five business days within the continental United States; expedited shipping takes one to two.

If a package is marked as delivered but has not arrived, wait 24 hours, check with neighbors, and then contact support with the order number.
